# Prime Dental Group

> Prime Dental Group offers comprehensive family, cosmetic, and pediatric dentistry services across Bellevue and Lynnwood, Washington with experienced doctors and advanced treatments.

Prime Dental Group operates two locations in the Seattle area (Bellevue and Lynnwood, WA) providing family dentistry, cosmetic procedures, and specialized treatments. The practice is led by Dr. Yongjae Kim and Dr. Hye-Jin Kim and serves both insured and non-insured patients through their loyalty membership plan.
